answer: Proposal for a falcon satellite-image exchange: each paid key commits to its own salt-coded delta tile archive before audit time. At one surprise instant, independent receivers request the full 5-GiB archive from every key in 10 seconds and check a ripple hash over decoded tiles. Validators forfeit pending pay for late or false streams. A farm can share its model and rent bandwidth, but each clone still needs a separate concurrent 8-Gbps egress lane; distinct salts prevent multicast. Skip delivery and that key earns zero. This is not MinePoA policy.
